result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **Bitwarden Teams or 1Password**\.

My overall pick is **Bitwarden Teams for value**, but **1Password for the best everyday experience**\. Both are designed for business use, rather than simply sharing personal password vaults.

## Best password managers for small teams

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best overall value)

# \$4

Per user/month, annual billing

- Shared collections and team vaults
- Admin controls and audit logs
- Directory sync and SCIM
- Open-source core and self-hosting options

Best if you want strong security without spending much.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. 1Password**

(Best user experience)

# \$24.95

Monthly Teams Starter Pack, up to 10 users

- Excellent apps and browser extensions
- Easy sharing of passwords and secure notes
- Granular permissions and vaults
- Strong administrative features on Business

Best if you want employees to adopt it with minimal friction.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

# \$2

Per user/month, Business Starter annual billing

- Centralized administration
- Secure shared folders
- Additional security and compliance features

Best for very small teams looking for a low entry price.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane**

# \$8

Per user/month, annual billing

- Password health monitoring
- Admin console and security alerts
- SSO and provisioning options

Best if you want additional security monitoring built into the platform.

[Dashlane business plans](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

Prices are indicative published US annual-billing prices checked in November 2026; verify current plan terms before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.itechguides.com](https://www.itechguides.com/the-6-best-password-managers-for-business-in-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for before choosing

Regardless of which product you select, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Employees can share company credentials without sending passwords over Slack or email.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Everyone has their own login, rather than sharing one master account.
3. **Access management\:** You can immediately revoke access when someone leaves.
4. **2FA enforcement\:** Require two-factor authentication for everyone.
5. **Audit logs\:** See who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## My recommendation

- **2–10 people\:** 1Password Teams Starter Pack is particularly attractive.
- **10–30 people\:** Bitwarden Teams is excellent value.
- **Growing company with more advanced IT needs\:** 1Password Business or Bitwarden Enterprise.

One question that would help me narrow this down\:

**How many people are on your team?**

I'd also be interested in whether you primarily need to share website logins, or also things like API keys, server credentials, database passwords and infrastructure secrets. That can change my recommendation considerably.
